lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular array of high-luminance circular pixel clusters (local maxima) arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns and four horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Orthogonal intersecting bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity forming a grid-like pattern; the high-luminance blobs are primarily localized at the center of the quadrilateral nodes formed by these bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous linear feature exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient (specular highlight on the dorsal edge, shadow on the ventral edge) extending horizontally from the posterior of the head across the upper mid-flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of discrete high-luminance points within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin silhouette, with a higher spatial frequency observed near the basal attachment area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or indentation is visible on the posterior (trailing) edge of the left pectoral fin, located approximately one-third the distance from the fin tip toward the base.
other_distinctive_markers: Several elongated, low-luminance objects (consistent with commensal fish) are visible in close proximity to the ventral-lateral surface.
